2026-09-15, normalized 32x32 import-ready terrain atlas built by individually cropping/resizing 37 tiles from mq0_terrain_forest_v2_source.png (grass/water/shore/cliff/waterfall; RGBA, 256x288, clean 32px multiples). Directional variants (path end/corner, shore N/S/E/W, vertical cliff face) are geometric rotations/mirrors of captured art, documented per-tile via mq0Label. 2026-09-17: appended 15 new 'wide dirt road' blob-autotile tiles (dirt_full, dirt_edge_n/s/e/w, dirt_corner_ne/nw/se/sw, dirt_inner_ne/nw/se/sw, dirt_variant_01/02) into previously-unused atlas slots -- synthesized by masked-blending the existing grass_base texture with a dirt sample lifted from the existing path_cross tile (soft, noise-perturbed borders, no new source art), so the atlas stays 256x288 with 52 total tiles and every pre-existing GID is unchanged. Fully applied to tiled/maps/mq0_map01_starting_place_day.tmj: grass/water/shore/cliff/waterfall AND the dirt road are now formal (old thin 1-tile connector tiles path_straight_*/path_corner_*/path_cross/path_end_*/path_patch_* remain in the atlas unused). All props (trees, bushes, rocks, flowers, logs, torches, campfire, signpost, bridge) are formalized on their own dedicated tilesets (trees/props/bridge v2). See docs/PHASE_NO01_OUTDOOR_TILESET_SPEC.md for the full pipeline.

SOURCE only -- never registered directly as a Tiled tileset.

2026-09-16, normalized 32x32-cell import-ready props atlas (256x608 RGBA) built from mq0_props_forest_v2_source.png: 27 sprites (campfire lit/unlit 2x2, torch lit/unlit 1x2 plus a 1x1 'torch_lit_01_compact' fallback for tight spots, 4 logs 2x1/1x2, 2 signposts 1x2, 2 stumps 2x2, 7 rocks 1x1-3x2, 3 flowers 1x1, 4 weeds 1x1), individually cropped, largest-connected-component denoised, and resized with premultiplied alpha. Applied to tiled/maps/mq0_map01_starting_place_day.tmj replacing DEV_PLACEHOLDER campfire_marker/log_stump/torch_marker/rock_boulder/flower_patch with a hand-composed asymmetric campfire plaza and two north-gate torches. 2026-09-16, raw bridge sheet ('MQ0 Bridge Forest v2'): 1448x1086 RGBA with genuine (non-chroma-key) transparency, 30 sprites (horizontal railing end-caps and repeatable center panels, freestanding posts, unused vertical bridge deck pieces with no matching end-caps). SOURCE only -- never registered directly as a Tiled tileset.

2026-09-16, normalized 32x32-cell modular horizontal-bridge atlas (256x128 RGBA) built from mq0_bridge_forest_v2_source.png: bridge_h_left/right (1x2, end caps with a diagonal support strut) + bridge_h_center_01/02 (1x2, a plank-width slice of a railing panel, verified to tile seamlessly against itself and the other variant in any order) + bridge_post_01/02 (1x2, base cell blocking). Any bridge length >= 2 tiles is reachable in 1-tile steps via center repeats; verified with 3/5/7-tile test bridges. Deck tiles carry no collision (river Collision is untouched elsewhere); applied to tiled/maps/mq0_map01_starting_place_day.tmj replacing the 7-tile DEV_PLACEHOLDER bridge_wood at its existing position/width. See docs/PHASE_NO01_OUTDOOR_TILESET_SPEC.md.

2026-09-15, first pass at a real outdoor tileset (1448x1086 RGB). Measured native cell pitch is ~71-72px, not 32px or a clean multiple of it; no alpha channel; cliff/long-bridge art is drawn as one continuous mural rather than independent repeatable tiles. Good style/color/tree-size direction, but not sliceable into a production .tsj as-is. See docs/PHASE_NO01_OUTDOOR_TILESET_SPEC.md for the full evaluation and the regeneration checklist. Do not treat as ready_to_import until re-exported at a clean 32px multiple with transparency and modular cliff/bridge pieces.
